backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented frontend files to feature requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing human‑written summaries of all frontend components and config files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and custom CSS variables defining a romantic OKLCH theme with light/dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component rendering the ProposeDayPage.
frontend/src/components/propose-day/Foot: Romantic footer with branding, heart icons, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/propose-day/Hero: Full‑screen hero with background images, heading, subtext, and CTA that scrolls to the proposal section.
frontend/src/components/propose-day/Mess: Heartfelt message section inside a styled card with romantic text.
frontend/src/components/propose-day/Prop: Interactive proposal component with states for default, yes, and not‑yet responses.
Wrapper section that centers and displays the ProposalInteraction component.
frontend/src/components/propose-day/Reas: Grid of cards listing reasons for adoration, each with an icon and description.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook creating and managing an authenticated or anonymous backend actor via React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks to manage Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, including login flow, stored identity loading, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file exporting nothing for client-only apps without backend queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines base styles, fonts, Tailwind layers, and a romantic rose-themed color palette with light/dark variants.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/ProposeDayPage.tsx: Composes the Propose Day page layout by stacking themed content sections within a gradient background.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container settings, and plugins for the romantic design theme.
project_state.json: Metadata describing the project’s goals, features, required assets, and high-level Propose Day page requirements.
